result.interpretation: Cross-artifact integrity audit over sixteen real reports. Metrics answer different questions; none alone demonstrates recursive self-improvement.

RSI-Index.limit: Undefined at a saturated initial score; inheritance and cost are separate.
RSI-Index.problem: Normalize fractions of remaining score gaps.
RSI-Index.use: Comparable reward benchmarks with a meaningful ceiling.

recursive learnability.limit: Cannot be inferred from one static score.
recursive learnability.problem: Choose informative self-play tasks as skills change.
recursive learnability.use: Controlled orchestration rollouts with skill withdrawal.

swarm diversity.limit: Diversity alone does not imply correctness or gain.
swarm diversity.use: Population search with externally tested descendants.
